messages:
Mia (runtime): quick question — can we run a small integration canary for the new 'stitch' kernel tomorrow? want to validate fused-op correctness across paged-attn and flash paths.
Sam (infra): yes, I can carve out a 2h slot on the gpu pool (gpus-prod-canary). prefer morning or late evening?
Mia (runtime): morning is better for us. can we do 09:00 UTC? gives us time to triage before EOD.
Jun (ml-kernel): 09:00 UTC works. i'll attach a minimal config that exercises KV cache wrap, varying seq lengths (512, 2048) and mixed quantization.
Ara (perf): also add a single trace with sequence=8192 for the paged path — just one sample to smoke memory behavior.
Mia (runtime): perfect. Jun — can you paste the run command and the env vars we'll need?
Jun (ml-kernel): sure — here's the runner snippet:
```bash
export REDWOOD_CANARY=true
export STITCH_ENABLE=true
python run_canary.py --model redwood-1b --kernels stitch,flash,paged --seq-lens 512,2048,8192 --iters 30 --collect-traces /tmp/canary_traces
```
Sam (infra): FYI I'll mount an empty S3 prefix for artifacts: s3://redwood-canary/artifacts/1968005678-stitch. make sure the script uploads traces there. permissions set for eng-runtime and ml-kernel.
Mia (runtime): Jun, also include the kernel-version tag in the artifact names (git SHA) so we can map regressions.
Jun (ml-kernel): will do. i'll name artifacts like `stitch-<sha>-<seq>-<ts>.tar.gz`.
Ara (perf): quick ask: can we enable high-res CPU sampling for the first 3 iters? that helps find unexpected host-side stalls. set `PERF_SAMPLING=1` in the env.
Mia (runtime): added to checklist. Sam — do we have enough logging quota for traces + perf profiles?
Sam (infra): yes but need to bump retention for this prefix to 30d. done. also added a 2x network egress cap in case upload spikes.
deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled for 1968006010 on gpus-prod-canary (owner: Sam). Logs to s3://redwood-canary/artifacts/1968005678-stitch/
Mia (runtime): thanks bot. Jun — after the run, please post the top 5 diffs from the golden runs and ping me. if latency/regression shows >10% for median tokens we abort rollout.
Jun (ml-kernel): noted. i'll run golden locally (stitch@main) before canary and upload diffs as `diffs-<sha>.json`.
Ara (perf): i'll prepare a small perf dashboard slice for the run: model, kernel, seq, p50/p95/p99, mem-peak. Jun — share trace IDs once uploaded.
Mia (runtime): one more thing — code review ping: there's an open PR #3241 that touches kernel dispatch. can the author @Jun link that in thread so we can cross-check?
Jun (ml-kernel): PR link: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/runtime/pull/3241 — it contains the kernel stitch selector and a fallback to legacy when mismatch detected. I added unit tests but want integration coverage tomorrow.
Sam (infra): i'll watch the run and keep a terminal open. if uploads fail i'll fallback to collecting locally and rsync to infra host.
Mia (runtime): great. anyone object to a quick 30m sync 30min after the run to review artifacts?
Ara (perf): +1
Sam (infra): +1
Jun (ml-kernel): +1
Mia (runtime): ok that's a wrap. thanks all — i'll create a checklist issue with the canary steps and link artifacts after the run. :rocket:
